examShortTricks: Trick 1: Innate (inborn, non-specific, 4 barriers: physical skin/mucus, physiological acid/tears, cellular WBC, cytokine) vs adaptive (acquired, specific, memory) — the two-column contrast is the whole answer.
Trick 2: Cell-mediated (T cells, graft rejection) vs humoral (B cells → antibodies) — name the two arms of adaptive immunity.
Trick 3: Active immunity (own antibodies, slow, long-lasting, vaccination) vs passive (borrowed antibodies, immediate, short, e.g. maternal IgG) — the comparison table.
Trick 4: AIDS attacks helper T cells → both arms fail — the immunology link line.
